statement: Seaweed (D012624) — MeSH 2026 scope note: Multicellular marine macroalgae including some members of red (RHODOPHYTA), green (CHLOROPHYTA), and brown (PHAEOPHYCEAE) algae. statement: Synapses (D013569) — MeSH 2026 scope note: Specialized junctions at which a neuron communicates with a target cell. Several other non-synaptic chemical or electric signal transmitting processes occur via extracellular mediated interactions.
